description: A dark-haired man seen from behind, in scale armour over a short tattered tunic with a leather belt, raises a long sword high in his right hand. He faces a crowd of bearded men in rough brown tunics, some with spears, round shields and a dagger. A torch burns on the right. The setting is a rocky ravine with dead branches, and a broken fluted stone column with a carved capital lies in rubble at the front. The composition is a painting that fills the frame edge to edge. No text, frame or wounds are visible.
